newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Eminent judges and lawyers of the sub-continent at a seminar in Dhaka on Sunday emphasised on making justice cheap, quicker and easily accessible for the commong people.
At least 17 people died in the cold wave now sweeping the northern region of the country.
Finance Minister S A M S Kibria said on Sunday that the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) would be recast in a day or two to enable it to work with more efficiency and transparency.
A high powered inter-ministreal committee has been set up to accelerate the flow of foreign investment.
President Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed has summoned Parliament into winter session on January 15.

Suspension of production in Chittagong Urea Fertiliser Ltd (CUFL), the country's largest fertiliser factory, may cause a loss of 3 billion taka to the exchequer in the current winter. The CUFL authorities was forced to cease its operation since December 10 due to disconnection of gas supply.
